children.characters: Bubble

children.name: Description
children.characters: Displays conversational content in a message bubble. Supports variants, alignment, grouping, reactions, and collapsible content.

children.name: Heading
children.characters: Alignment

children.name: Description
children.characters: Use align on Bubble to align the bubble to the start or end of the conversation.

children.name: Heading
children.characters: Bubble Group

children.name: Description
children.characters: Use BubbleGroup to group consecutive bubbles from the same sender. Note the align prop should be set on the Bubble component itself, not the BubbleGroup component.

children.name: Heading
children.characters: Links and Buttons

children.name: Description
children.characters: You can turn a bubble into a link or button by using the asChild prop on BubbleContent.

children.name: Heading
children.characters: Reactions

children.name: Description
children.characters: Use BubbleReactions for bubble reactions. You can use it to display reactions or quick action buttons. Use side and align to position the row — side="top" anchors it to the upper edge. Reactions overlap the bubble edge, so leave vertical space between rows — the examples below use a larger gap for this reason.

children.name: Heading
children.characters: Show More / Collapsible

children.name: Description
children.characters: Long bubble content can be composed with Collapsible to allow for a show more or show less interaction. Use the CollapsibleTrigger component to trigger the collapsible content.

to allow for a show more or show less interaction. Use the CollapsibleTrigger component to trigger the collapsible content.

children.name: Heading
children.characters: Tooltip

children.name: Description
children.characters: Wrap a bubble in a Tooltip to reveal metadata on hover, such as when a message was read.

runs.text: to reveal metadata on hover, such as when a message was read.

children.name: Heading
children.characters: Popover

children.name: Description
children.characters: Pair a bubble with a Popover to surface more information on demand, such as the full error message for a failed action.

runs.text: to surface more information on demand, such as the full error message for a failed action.

children.name: The accessibility review found two focus states that were visually too subtle in dark mode. I checked the dialog, menu, and drawer paths because each one renders focusable controls inside a layered surface. The dialog and drawer are fine. The menu needs the hover and focus tokens split so keyboard focus stays visible when the pointer is not involved. I also recommend keeping the change in the style file instead of the primitive so the other themes can choose their own focus treatment later.
